boundaries.rollback: Omit --profile-variance or revert its atomic local commit; existing arithmetic and GPU synchronization topology stay unchanged.

geometry.dtype: Existing BF16 storage and qualified F32 FFN/head/RMS graph math.

method.metadata_collection: After the existing terminal wait and outside execution timing.
method.gpu_partition_rule: A time segment is classified only when all active root candidates map to the same coarse group. Cross-group candidates/overlap stay ambiguous.
method.clock_scope: Native mach ticks join API/GPU intervals; existing guard mach timestamp joins guard/request windows. Wall minus owner-thread CPU is not proof of a wait.
method.on_off_limit: A has both orders; B has one profile-on clean/poison ordered pair. No randomized stable overhead estimate.

numerical.capture_scope: Attention 0-35, outputs 34/35 and five head stages; overwritten output aliases 0-33 are not retained.

execution.named_counter_scope: ML::MetalBuffer; opaque MPS resources are not enumerated separately.

timing.scope: Prepared request execution including intervening telemetry, excluding preparation and postterminal comparisons. GPU groups partition command-buffer residency, not kernel work.
timing.interpretation: Same-input drift exists with profiler off; clean B is slow before poison. FFN group union is substantial. Attention continuation spans overlap prior work. Union deltas are not causal contributions to request wall.
timing.next_falsifier: One multi-output gate/up graph sharing the activation F32 cast, retaining separate weight casts and BF16 outputs; qualify unchanged parity, peak and paired native timing. Coarse FFN intervals do not isolate cast cost.
timing.next_candidate_source: src/ml/video/pixelumm_decoder_block_mps_bridge.mm:551-593,1381-1389,1580-1583. Separate graphs declare repeated casts; MPSGraph may fuse/cache internally.

oracle.policy: Reused authenticated upstream source-method MPS controls and exact composition edge; no fresh connected upstream neural run or independent backend.
oracle.payload_authentication: Native construction authenticates block/cache/head payloads. CPU audit verifies small metadata/capture identities and inherits exact composition-edge audit. No fresh connected upstream neural run.

failed_epochs_preserved.trace-self-test-v1: External harness wrongly required wall >= thread CPU despite clock granularity; v2 checks both clocks without changing numerical tolerances.
failed_epochs_preserved.variance-audit-v1: Mixed tuple/list sorting raised TypeError; v2 sorts by time keys. No native arithmetic change.

executed_dod.expected: Six full-J requests: 258 finite captures within unchanged tolerance, complete roots/markers/trace/API geometry, one wait and zero preterminal reads/named encode allocations; guard and temporal arithmetic checks pass.
executed_dod.observed: PASS within measurement/parity/sampled guard scope; no stable speedup or physical-cause claim.
executed_dod.no_clobber: Recorded output names are consumed. Repeats need fresh names and refreshed memory admission.

reviews.limits: Same lineage and MPS backend; no large payload rehash or fresh connected neural oracle.
